Diagnostic task; no engine code changed. Executed 2026-09-09; scripts and records committed in 7eea6b95 (2026-10-04). Closed after the 2026-10-08 close-out and after its rewritten harnesses ran on the current build (item 2.3; package .screenshots/flicker-elimination/11-isolate-flicker-display-2026-10/, result recorded in notes.md). On 2026-10-09 (Debug build of 2cc2e85c) the replay passed 8/8 and the study 7/8, its auto-exposure equivalence passing the pre-registered re-run its protocol asks for (scripts/run_display_exposure_rerun.py, read as chance).

Findings, with their rows in docs/analysis/flicker-hypothesis-ledger.md:
- The offline tonemap replay (scripts/flicker/display_model.py) reproduces the engine PNG to 1 code value with bloom off.
- Display threshold counts are a property of the exposure. The identical HDR at 0.5x/1x/2x gives 0.65/1.65/22.04 px > 40 per frame, 33.8x for a 4x exposure change (H-15b, correcting H-15's 31x).
- Bloom lowers the counts at exposure 1.0 and, per the 2026-09-09 package, at the ~67 operating point. It therefore masks the residual rather than amplifying it (H-16b, correcting H-16's sign misreading). The ~67 figure comes from one run; step 5b of the rewritten study repeated it on 2026-10-09: bloom lowers px > 40 from about 1652 to 40 per frame in all four processes.
- H-05b supersedes H-05: exposure amplification is supported, bloom amplification is rejected.
- r.TAA.PreExposeWeights is a no-op at exposure 1.0 and destabilises the bright side 11x at the operating point (H-08b).
- r.GI.Reflections=0 substitutes the prefiltered IBL for the SDF trace rather than subtracting it (H-02b). This is still the code path in deferred_lighting_ps.hlsl lines 1100-1106 and 1156-1163, with SSR blended over either layer since 9f1be63f.
- Moving-camera auto-exposure was measured by followup-14 (coverage.json: 66.1-73.2, adapting without oscillating), not by followup-13 as first recorded.

The 2026-10-08 close-out corrected the records in place with dated notes and recovered the surviving 2026-09-09 run evidence into the package (recovered-2026-10-08/). It also rewrote scripts/test_display_replay.py, scripts/run_display_study.py and scripts/report_display_study.py:
- Cross-process bit-identity checks became repeated, interleaved processes. These are judged by max(between) <= max(within) on max |delta| (the rule pre-registered in scripts/run_default_vs_explicit.py, adopted by scripts/test_correction_gates.py), plus a mean |delta| that must not read SEPARATED.
- A vacuous check(True) became a reflections-off substitution check.
- Manifests, logs, PNGs and first-process dumps are retained, and packages are never overwritten.
- An operating-exposure bloom step was added.
- The report text is derived from the data.

The visible flicker is not closed by this task. It remains with phase0_sponza-followup-12 and phase0_sponza-followup-14; followup-14 also owns the untried display-side candidates listed in docs/analysis/known-issues-and-partial-implementations.md.
